_comment: Hand judgments for the events the v1 corpus could not distinguish — it merged each of these with a sibling, keeping whichever came first as the representative, so no v1 label covers them. Keyed by the masked line text rather than by id, so it survives a fixture regeneration. relabel.py requires an entry here for every event it cannot inherit, and fails if one is missing.
